# Oahu Web Co.

> Oahu Web Co. (also written Oahu Webco; website oahuwebco.com) helps small businesses on Oʻahu, Hawaii, trade businesses first, get more of the right customers online. Based in Kāneʻohe, Oʻahu. The online side, handled.

## What we do

- [Reach more customers](https://oahuwebco.com/reach-more-customers/): local search, Google Business Profiles, websites and online ads for Oʻahu businesses.
- [Convert more inquiries](https://oahuwebco.com/convert-more-inquiries/): call handling, fast replies and estimate follow-up, so more inquiries become booked jobs.
- [Build repeat business](https://oahuwebco.com/build-repeat-business/): reviews, service reminders and referrals that bring customers back.
- [Measure and improve](https://oahuwebco.com/measure-and-improve/): call and form tracking and a short monthly report showing which channels bring in paid jobs.

## How it works

- Every client starts with a free review of how customers find them, contact them and come back.
- Paid work is quoted after the review. Estimates: Foundation $750–$1,500 one-time; Ongoing growth $300–$750 per month, month to month; Websites about $500.
- No guarantees of rankings, calls or revenue.

## Who it's for

Owner-run contractors and trade businesses on Oʻahu (roofing, HVAC, landscaping, pressure washing, gutters, pest control and similar), and other local small businesses that want more calls and jobs.

## Who's behind it

- [Who's behind Oahu Web Co.](https://oahuwebco.com/about/): started in Kāneʻohe by Max, a U.S. Army veteran.
